name: Australia
tagline: World-class universities with post-study work rights
description: World-class education, post-study work rights of up to 4 years, and vibrant student life in Sydney, Melbourne & Brisbane. Strong STEM focus with industry connections.
longDescription: Australia is the third most popular destination for international students globally. With 43 universities and a strong emphasis on research and practical skills, Australian qualifications are recognised worldwide. The country offers a multicultural environment, excellent quality of life, and one of the most generous post-study work visa regimes.
highlights: No cap on international student visas
Work 48 hours per fortnight during studies
Spouse/partner can work full time
Clear PR pathways via skilled migration
Globally recognised qualifications

name: United Kingdom
tagline: Historic universities with shorter master's programs
description: Historic universities like Oxford, Cambridge, LSE. Shorter 1-year master's programs and the Graduate Route visa for 2 years post-study.
longDescription: The UK is home to some of the world's oldest and most prestigious universities. With over 160 higher education institutions, the UK offers exceptional academic programmes across all disciplines. The introduction of the Graduate Route visa has made the UK even more attractive for international students.
postStudyWork: 2 years (Graduate Route); 3 years for PhD graduates
highlights: 1-year master's programmes save time and money
Graduate Route visa: 2 years post-study work
Dependants allowed for courses 9+ months
Access to EU job markets via Northern Ireland
Part-time work: 20 hrs/week during term

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Nepali professionals with 2+ years work experience

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Full funding for master's and PhD

name: Canada
tagline: Affordable education with clear PR pathways
description: Affordable tuition, multicultural society, and a clear pathway to permanent residency through Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs.
longDescription: Canada is consistently ranked among the world's best countries to live and work. Its education system is world-class and affordable compared to the US and UK. Canada's immigration-friendly policies make it the top choice for students seeking long-term settlement options.
postStudyWork: Up to 3 years (PGWP – Post-Graduate Work Permit)
highlights: PGWP allows work in any field after graduation
Express Entry PR within 6 months of eligibility
Spouse/partner gets open work permit
Can work 20 hrs/week on campus (off campus from 2024: 24 hrs/week)
Provincial Nominee Programs (PNP) for PR

scholarships.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Doctoral candidates with high academic standing

name: United States
description: Home to 50+ world top-100 universities. STEM OPT extension of up to 3 years. Strong research opportunities and campus diversity.
longDescription: The United States remains the world's top destination for international students, boasting the largest number of top-ranked universities. US degrees carry global prestige, and STEM graduates benefit from extended OPT allowing them to work and gain US experience.
postStudyWork: 1 year OPT; 3 years for STEM graduates
highlights: 3-year STEM OPT extension
On-campus employment allowed from day one
World's largest research funding ecosystem
Campus Practical Training (CPT) during study
Diverse campuses across 50 states

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.coverage: Full funding including tuition, stipend, health insurance
scholarships.eligibility: Nepali students for Master's and PhD

name: Europe
description: Germany, Netherlands, France & Nordic countries offer low or zero tuition fees. English-taught programs. Schengen access to 27 countries.
longDescription: Europe offers incredible diversity in education, language, and culture. Countries like Germany offer tuition-free education even for international students. The Schengen zone allows students to travel freely across 27 countries, and English-taught programmes are widely available.
highlights: Germany: No tuition fees for all students
Schengen visa: travel 27 EU countries
DAAD & Erasmus scholarships widely available
Low cost of living compared to UK/Australia
Strong industry ties especially in engineering

name: New Zealand
description: Safe, nature-rich country with high QS-ranked universities. Spouse open work permit and excellent post-study opportunities.
longDescription: New Zealand offers a safe, welcoming environment with world-ranked universities. It is known for its stunning landscapes, high quality of life, and progressive student policies. The Post-Study Work Visa allows graduates to work anywhere in New Zealand for up to 3 years.
highlights: Spouse/partner gets open work permit
Work 20 hrs/week during study
8 world top-500 universities in one small country
One of the world's safest countries
PR possible after 2 years of skilled work

name: Japan
description: Cutting-edge technology, robotics, and engineering programs. MEXT government scholarships available. Unique cultural experience.
longDescription: Japan offers unique academic experiences combining cutting-edge technology with rich cultural heritage. Japanese universities excel in engineering, robotics, and technology. The MEXT scholarship is one of the most prestigious and fully-funded scholarships available to Nepali students.
postStudyWork: Designated Activities Visa (up to 2 years for job hunting)
highlights: MEXT scholarship: full funding from Japanese government
World leader in engineering and robotics
Extremely safe country
Part-time work allowed: 28 hrs/week
Rich cultural and networking opportunities

scholarships.name: MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Nepali students under 35 with strong academics

name: Ireland
tagline: English-speaking EU gateway for tech careers
description: English-speaking EU country. Home to tech giants (Google, Meta, Apple). 2-year Stay Back visa for graduates. Gateway to EU.
longDescription: Ireland is the only English-speaking country remaining in the European Union after Brexit. It has become the European HQ for many tech giants including Google, Meta, Apple, and LinkedIn, creating outstanding employment opportunities for graduates.
highlights: Only English-speaking EU member state
European HQ of Google, Meta, Apple, LinkedIn
2-year stay-back visa after graduation
Gateway to EU job market
Work 20 hrs/week during study, 40 hrs in holidays

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
